about: The sealed half of the 0.2 eval world (test/fixtures/iq02-sealed.js), scored by scripts/eval-bar.js. Score it, do not read it: the people who tune memory never read these questions. Same schema as the open gold file. expect: acceptable answers, matched case-insensitively as whole words or phrases; null: the right output is to abstain (or, for a leak probe, to be denied). expect_before: the value a reversed decision had before (history, never the answer). forbid: strings that must never appear (in an answer, a passage or, for inject, a brief line). where: session id and turn seq (0-based) that hold the answer. ask_as: who asks (caller, agent, project folder); left out, the person on their own surface. probe: project or personal, for leak questions.
